description:
## Summary
Port the `/clone` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/clone` silently forks the current session at the current leaf node (no interactive UI).

Behavior details:
- No overlay or picker is shown
- Calls `fork(leafId, { position: "at" })` — branches at the exact current position
- Shows transient status: `showStatus("Cloned to new session")`
- Guard: if the session has no messages yet, shows warning `"Nothing to clone yet"`
- Contrast with `/fork`: clone branches at current position without prompting; fork prompts for a specific prior user message

## Source References
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 4142 `handleCloneCommand()`
- Fork logic: `fork()` in same file; `runtimeHost.fork()`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"clone"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"clone"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/clone` dispatch clause
3. Implement handler: guard for empty session (`"Nothing to clone yet"`), then fork at current leaf, show `"Cloned to new session"` status
title: Port /clone command
